findings.current: her youngest boy—far too young to be on his own—would survive
findings.defect: The source says her youngest son was far too young, but does not say he was too young to be on his own. That adds a specific implication about his independence.
findings.rationale: 턱없이 어린 describes the son as far too young; it does not specify what he was too young to do.
findings.replacement: her youngest boy—still far too young—would survive

findings.current: he was about to shoot forward and tear the Emperor to pieces.
findings.defect: The source says he shot forward toward the Emperor, intending to tear him to pieces. “Was about to shoot forward” reduces that movement to an impending action.
findings.rationale: 쏘아져 describes him shooting forward; the following clause gives his intent. The voice interrupts at that moment.
findings.replacement: he shot forward, intent on tearing the Emperor to pieces.

summary: Two minor fidelity issues remain: an unsupported implication about the boy’s independence and a softened description of the Demon Lord’s lunge.
